task: Continuous Li concentration regression and predictive factor importance; original code as baseline.
parameter_selection: training CV only; MLP convergence required; all fixed-test gains and losses retained
final_prediction: max(raw_prediction,0), fixed physical lower limit; threshold not learned
importance: 20 shared permutations, seed42; original 18-col block jointly shuffled; modified shared group retained as one column. Final importance scorer uses the same physical lower limit.
validation: All four delivered scripts executed; predictions, original Excel row IDs, metrics and permutation importance matched frozen experiment outputs. Report rendered to 15-page PDF and layout checked.
limitations: Internal development validation; no external independent validation; importance is not causal; MLP gain dominated by one invalid negative prediction.
